scope: All unordered solid-body pairs from independent declared scene, including unknown inputs; all forbidden contacts checked, no exclusions except explicitly verified linked punch/product interface in linked scenarios.

A-READY.note: Explicit time-synchronized geometry and physical interlocks required.
exclusions: Intentional punch/material contact: physical interface UNKNOWN, not treated as free clearance.
Stop/lock and stop/product geometry is checked as interference in moving phases; any intended final bearing/contact needs a separate contact definition, never automatic permission.
Wall objects are explicit solid wall pieces; omitted pieces are UNKNOWN, not empty space.
Non-moving/irrelevant pairs omitted only when explicitly not part of the supported check: no claim for real machine.
